text:
‹4Q531 frg.1:1-8›
[The Watch]ers defiled themselves...
...giants and Nephilim...
...whom [the Watchers] fathered, and these were like [mighty men?]...
...in blood, and by the hand of [death?]...
...[giants] for whom there was not enough, neither for them nor for [their sons]...
...and they sought much food from...
...

‹4Q531 frg.2+3:1-10›
...[the] Nephilim opened [or began]...
...the moon...
...[all that] the earth produced...
...[the] heavens and all the great fish...
...and every bird of heaven with every wild creature...
...and with the seed-bearing plants of the earth, all grain, and all trees...
...and with sheep, cattle, and small livestock...
...and every creeping thing of the earth, and afterward all...
...every harsh deed and rebellious word from...
...male and female, and among human beings...
...knowledge, wisdom, and mercy...
